verdict.rationale: Bugbot has a documented 'Automatically Learn Rules' toggle, which points to learning team conventions over time. It also supports persistent convention files (.cursor/BUGBOT.md), org-wide rules via Bugbot Automations, and a verbose mode that shows which rules loaded. However, the learning feature appears only as a single toggle mention, with no detail on how it captures past review decisions. One hands-on report also shows Bugbot repeating a recommendation the user had already argued against and reverted, which undercuts its memory of past decisions. Missing for 10: documentation of how learned rules are derived from past review decisions and stored across PRs, evidence that learned memory changes future reviews, and independent corroboration that the learning works.
